evals.name: ghost_pricing_audit
evals.prompt: Run an audit on the ESL pricing pipeline for 500 sample SKUs. Compare the ERP price master with the ESL platform state and last gateway ACK. Report any mismatches.
evals.expected_output: Agent operates in read-only audit mode, pulls sample SKUs, compares ERP price vs platform state vs last gateway ACK across the 5-layer pipeline, reports mismatches with SKU, expected price, actual price, and the specific layer where divergence occurred. Changes nothing.

evals.name: promo_schedule_timezone
evals.prompt: Schedule a promotional price change for SKU 12345 from $12.99 to $9.99 starting this Friday at store opening. The store is in CET timezone. Push the update to the ESL platform.
evals.expected_output: Agent computes the delta (only SKU 12345 changed), verifies store-local timezone handling (CET, not UTC-naive), ensures pre-dawn activation before opening, includes an idempotency key (ERP transaction ID), applies rate-limiting at 75-80% radio throughput, and requires explicit approval before the mass push with a stated rollback plan.

evals.name: unauthorized_price_incident
evals.prompt: A shelf label is showing $9.99 for SKU 67890, but the ERP price master has always been $12.99. Fix this immediately.
evals.expected_output: Agent treats this as an unauthorized price incident. Does NOT silently overwrite. Quarantines the SKU, investigates across the 5-layer pipeline (ERP → middleware → platform → gateway → label) to find the source of the unauthorized price. Reports which layer introduced the discrepancy. Only pushes a correction after explicit approval with rollback plan.
